name: crawlgraph-datasets
title: CrawlGraph Datasets
description: Open backlink-overlap datasets from Common Crawl's hyperlink graph, published by crawlgraph.com. Each dataset lists the domains that link to most of the tools in a category (the niche's universal linkers).

resources.name: seo-tools-universal-linkers
resources.title: Domains that link to every major SEO tool
resources.description: Referring domains linking to 6 or more of 8 major SEO tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, Majestic, Serpstat, SE Ranking, SpyFu, Surfer), ranked by overlap and authority.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: A domain that links to several of the tools.

fields.name: links_to_n_of_8
fields.description: How many of the 8 tools it links to.

fields.name: cg_authority
fields.description: CrawlGraph authority score for the linking domain, 0 to 100.

resources.name: crm-universal-linkers
resources.title: Domains that link to every major CRM
resources.description: Referring domains linking to 6 or more of 8 major CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Freshworks, Close, Copper, Attio, Salesflare), ranked by overlap and authority.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: A domain that links to several of the CRMs.

fields.name: links_to_n_of_8
fields.description: How many of the 8 CRMs it links to.

fields.name: cg_authority
fields.description: CrawlGraph authority score for the linking domain, 0 to 100.
